passage 1:What is that picture above you might ask yourself?? Well, it is a water pik. Most people are very unfamiliar with what a water pik is so I am here to educate you all on it. A water pik is designed to shoot a strong stream of water at your gum line to help eliminate those pesky germs and plaque that is tough to get rid of with a toothbrush.

passage 2:If you’re sizing up Waterpik vs. Flossing and wondering which one your dentist would recommend, which one is easier, and which one leaves your mouth feeling cleaner, you probably think the Waterpik would win hands down. passage 3:A Water Pik is useful in helping to maintain good oral health. It can massage and stimulate soft tissue in the mouth which helps to reduce the risk of gingivitis. Water Pik also helps to clean better around the teeth and gums, removing food from areas areas that brushing can not access.

Based on the given passages, the benefits of a water pick include:

* Helping to keep teeth, gums, mouth, and overall body healthier by eliminating germs and plaque that are difficult to remove with a toothbrush (Passage 1)
* Providing a stronger stream of water to clean around the gum line, leaving the mouth feeling cleaner (Passage 2)
* Massaging and stimulating soft tissue in the mouth to reduce the risk of gingivitis (Passage 3)
* Cleaning better around the teeth and gums, removing food from areas that brushing cannot access (Passage 3)
